Styleguide.title: Namieri styleguide
Styleguide.intro: Every token, type style and component, in Georgian and English, on navy, cream and white. This page is not indexed.

colour.lead: Midnight navy carries the brand, yogurt cream gives calm light sections, and gold is the rare premium signal. Ratios are computed from the hex values on this page.
colour.proportion: Proportion: about 60% navy, 30% cream and white, 8% gold, 2% glacier blue.
colour.rule: Never set gold-500 text on cream or white (2.1:1). Use gold-700.
colour.derived: Derived for dark surfaces (not in the Brief)

roles.navy-900: Primary brand background, hero, header on dark pages
roles.gold-500: Meander borders, hairlines, primary button fill, key numbers on navy
roles.gold-300: Hover state, small highlights on navy
roles.cream-50: Light section background, cards on navy
roles.white: Yogurt highlights, text on navy, input fields
roles.ink-900: Body text and headings on light backgrounds
roles.glacier-300: Focus rings and links on navy only, never large fills
roles.error-300: Error text and borders on navy

type.lead: Noto Serif Georgian and Cormorant Garamond for display, FiraGO for body and UI. Georgian gets 0.1 more line-height than Latin.
type.bodyKa: ნამიერი მზადდება თბილისში ქართული რძისა და ცოცხალი კულტურებისგან. ყოველი პარტია მოწმდება, რომ გემო ყოველთვის ერთნაირი იყოს.
type.bodyEn: Namieri is made in Tbilisi from Georgian milk and live cultures. Every batch is tested, so it tastes the same every time.
type.longHeadingSample: ხარისხი, სისუფთავე და სანდოობა — ბერძნული იოგურტი, რომელიც თავად გვინდოდა
type.spec: {min, number} → {max, number} px · line-height {lineLatin, number} Latin / {lineGeorgian, number} Georgian

space.lead: A 4/8 px spacing scale. Sections breathe: 64–96 px of padding on mobile, 96–160 px on desktop.
space.shadows: No heavy shadows: separation comes from hairlines and surface changes.

motifs.lead: Placeholders until the designer's files arrive. Replace the SVGs in public/brand/ and nothing else changes.

buttons.lead: Primary is gold with navy text. Secondary is a 1 px outline. Buttons grow with their label, never fixed width.

content.lead: Content blocks read from content/product.ts, so a price or nutrition change is a one-line edit.
content.videoNote: Poster first; plays muted and inline, pauses off-screen, and stays on the poster with reduced motion or Save-Data on.
content.featureOneText: Milk and live cultures. No additives, no preservatives, no vegetable fats.
content.featureTwoText: In one 150 g cup, with nothing else added.
content.featureThreeText: Made in Tbilisi under a HACCP food-safety system.
content.testimonialOne: Thick, clean and not sour. My breakfast every day now.
content.testimonialTwo: I read the label twice: just milk and cultures. That's why I switched.
content.imageAlt: Placeholder: a bowl of thick Greek yogurt with honey on linen

faq.a1: Keep it in the fridge at +2…+6 °C. Unopened, it keeps for 28 days; once opened, eat it within 5 days.
faq.a2: We deliver within Tbilisi. You can also order through Wolt from Namieri Saburtalo.
faq.a3: No. Straining removes some lactose, and 100 g contains 4 g of naturally occurring milk sugars. If you are lactose intolerant, check with your doctor.
faq.a4: Fresh dairy can't be returned. To cancel an order, contact us directly by phone or Instagram.

forms.lead: Fields are white with a stone border on every surface. Errors use text and an icon, never colour alone.

navigation.lead: The header is transparent over a navy hero and turns solid navy after 80 px of scroll. On mobile, the menu opens full-screen.
navigation.stickyNote: Visible at the bottom of the screen on phones once you scroll past the intro.

feedback.lead: Toasts announce politely to screen readers. Drawer and modal use the native dialog element: focus stays inside and Esc closes.

motion.lead: Slow and precise: fade with a 16 px rise over 600 ms, once. With reduced motion, everything is static.
motion.revealSample: This card fades in and rises 16 px the first time it scrolls into view.
motion.parallaxNote: The cup drifts at a slower speed than the page.
motion.pinnedNote: Scroll: the milk drop and culture merge into the cup. Pinned for 1.5 screens.
